title: Qcqs rational finite-model inputs are locally generated by integral coefficient extensions
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in a fixed algebraic closure, and a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme $V$. Let $\Lambda$ be $E$ (including $E=\mathbf Q_\ell$) or $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with the induced $\ell$-adic norm topology and its all-continuous-function condensed ring, exactly as in [sk-def-localizing-closure]. For $\Lambda=E$ set $\mathcal F=\{E\}$; for $\Lambda=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ let $\mathcal F$ be the set of finite extensions $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside this algebraic closure, in the universe [def-weil-size-convention]. For $F\in\mathcal F$ put $A=\mathcal O_F$ and $T_{F,V}(J)=\Lambda_V\otimes^L_{A_V}J$ in the ordinary unbounded module-object category [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Let $\mathcal G_V$ be the class of these objects for $J\in\mathrm D_{\mathrm{ctf}}(V,A)$ in the finite constant scalar-model sense [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Each object of $\mathcal G_V$ belongs to $\mathrm D_{\mathrm{ctf}}(V,\Lambda)$, and every object of $\mathrm D_{\mathrm{ctf}}(V,\Lambda)$ belongs to $\operatorname{Loc}(\mathcal G_V)$, with ambient ordinary coproducts and arbitrary $\Lambda_V$-linear morphisms in forming this localizing hull [sk-def-localizing-closure]. This asserts generation, not descent of an arbitrary complex or of its morphisms to one finite coefficient field. No Noetherian, characteristic, dimension or invertibility-of-$\ell$ hypothesis on $V$ is imposed.
